functions.name: scientific_to_common
functions.description: Looks up English common names for a character vector of scientific names. By default queries the GBIF vernacular names database (backbone_id=11) or ITIS (backbone_id=3); a backbone miss is left as NA unless use_llm=TRUE routes it to an LLM instead.

inputs.name: scientific_names
inputs.description: Scientific names to look up

inputs.name: backbone_id
inputs.description: Backbone for structured lookup: 11=GBIF (default, via rgbif), 3=ITIS (via taxize). Other values warn and fall through to the LLM. NULL skips backbone lookup entirely

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: Geographic context for the LLM (e.g. 'Southern California Bight'), biasing it toward regionally appropriate common names. No effect on backbone-sourced results

inputs.name: use_llm
inputs.description: If TRUE, taxa with no backbone result are sent to the LLM in batches of 20 names. FALSE (default) returns NA for unresolved taxa without an LLM call. A name the LLM omits from its batch response is NOT cached (per-row llm_parsed, 2026-09-13) -- it is re-asked on a later call rather than silently treated as a confirmed 'no common name' answer

inputs.name: llm_fn
inputs.description: Required when use_llm=TRUE or backbone_id is unsupported/NULL

inputs.name: cache_dir
inputs.description: A directory holding one small .rds per looked-up name, keyed on the name (case/whitespace-insensitive), backbone_id, and location. NULL (default) means no cache. A name found there is served without any backbone or LLM call; a name resolved this call is written back. A name the LLM was asked about and answered 'no common name' IS cached; one from an unparseable batch is NOT (re-asked); neither is a backbone miss on a use_llm=FALSE call. Manage with taxatools_clear_cache(). Added 2026-09-12 after a real 18S workflow spent 58 silent LLM calls on 1,151 names, then repeated them on every re-run

inputs.name: verbose
inputs.description: Print a one-line summary (cache/backbone/LLM counts) and one line per LLM batch

output.description: One row per element of scientific_names: scientific_name, common_name (primary English common name or NA), common_name_alternatives (semicolon-delimited additional names or NA), source ('gbif'/'itis'/'llm'/'none'), backbone_id (integer used, or NA for LLM/no-result rows)

functions.scaling_note: Backbone lookups are fast; use_llm=TRUE adds one LLM call per batch of 20 unresolved names. cache_dir makes repeat calls on the same names free

functions.name: assign_sampling_group
functions.description: Assign Sampling Groups from Taxonomic Rank Columns

inputs.name: taxonomy
inputs.description: A data frame (or tibble) with at least some of the columns named in rank_cols. Returned as-is with a new sampling_group column added.

inputs.name: scheme
inputs.description: A sampling-group scheme object; see default_sampling_scheme for the required shape. Supply a custom scheme (e.g. default_sampling_scheme() with an appended or edited rule) to override the default classification -- the whole rules/catch_all/kingdom_guard_vocabulary object is used exactly as supplied,

inputs.name: rank_cols
inputs.description: Character vector of taxonomic rank columns to read, in COARSE-TO-FINE order. Default c("kingdom", "phylum", "class", "order") -- the four ranks every rule in default_sampling_scheme() reads. A column absent from taxonomy is treated as entirely NA (never an error), so a taxonomy table missing e.g. or

inputs.name: kingdom_guard
inputs.description: Logical, default TRUE. When a row reaches the catch-all (scheme$catch_all, normally "macroinvertebrates") and its kingdom is NOT one of scheme$kingdom_guard_vocabulary (default c("Animalia", "Metazoa")), the row's sampling_group is set to NA instead of the catch-all. This is the single mechanism tha

inputs.name: harmonise
inputs.description: Logical, default FALSE. When TRUE, taxonomy is harmonised to scheme's backbone BEFORE classification, via verify_taxon_names(backbone_id = backbone_id) -> change_backbone() -- the same idiom CaliforniaIntertidal/scope_classifier.R's harmonize_ranks_to_gbif() documents, and the one PtConceptionWorkfl

inputs.name: backbone_id
inputs.description: Integer backbone ID passed to verify_taxon_names when harmonise = TRUE. Default 11L (GBIF), matching default_sampling_scheme()'s own vocabulary. Ignored when harmonise = FALSE.

inputs.name: cache_dir
inputs.description: Optional directory for a persistent, content-keyed cache of the harmonisation lookup (one .rds file, keyed on the sorted unique rank names actually resolved) -- only used, and only relevant, when harmonise = TRUE. NULL (default) does no caching, so every call re-resolves every unique name.

inputs.name: verbose
inputs.description: Logical, default TRUE. Print one table of the resulting sampling_group counts (including the NA count) after classification, and progress messages during harmonisation.

functions.name: cache_ok
functions.description: Is a cache file usable, given the inputs it derives from?

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Character. Path to the candidate cache file.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.description: Character vector or NULL. Paths this cache was derived FROM. Missing and NA entries are ignored, so a caller can pass an optional upstream without branching. If any surviving input is newer than path, the cache is rejected.

functions.name: call_api
functions.description: Call Any Configured LLM with a Single Prompt String

inputs.name: prompt_str
inputs.description: Character. A length-1 string containing the complete prompt to submit.

inputs.name: provider
inputs.description: Character. Provider name: "anthropic", "gemini", "openai", "azure_openai", "ollama", or any name registered with register_provider. Default NULL uses options("TaxaID.provider"), which is set automatically by library(TaxaTools) based on detected API keys.

inputs.name: tier
inputs.description: Character. Capability tier when model = NULL: "fast" (cheapest/smallest), "mid" (balanced, default), or "top" (most capable). Ignored when model is specified. Tier-to-model mapping is discovered live from the provider's /models endpoint (see list_models).

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Character. Exact model identifier. Overrides tier resolution. Use to pin a specific version for reproducibility.

inputs.name: max_tokens
inputs.description: Integer. Maximum tokens in the response (default 3000). The correct request body field for the provider (max_tokens vs max_completion_tokens) is read from the registry automatically.

inputs.name: api_key
inputs.description: Character. API key override. Default NULL reads the key from the environment variable named in the provider's registry entry (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Keyless providers (Ollama) ignore this.

inputs.name: base_url
inputs.description: Character. Base URL override for OpenAI-compatible providers (OpenAI, Azure, Ollama, custom registered providers). Default NULL uses the provider's registered endpoint. For Ollama: change the host/port, e.g. base_url = "http://remote-server:11434". For OpenAI-compatible proxies: supply the proxy bas

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: Named list of base64-encoded PNG strings, as returned by .render_pdf_pages() in the TaxaFetch PDF pipeline. Default NULL (text-only call). When supplied, the prompt and images are sent as a multi-modal message using the provider's vision format: Anthropic image content blocks, Gemini inlineData part

inputs.name: show_tokens
inputs.description: Logical. When TRUE, prints a message after each call reporting the provider, model, and token counts (e.g. "Tokens used [anthropic / claude-sonnet-4-6] — input: 312, output: 87"). Default FALSE to avoid output in non-interactive workflows. Token counts are retrieved from the provider's response body

inputs.name: max_input_tokens
inputs.description: Integer or NULL. When non-NULL, estimates the prompt length as ceiling(nchar(prompt_str) / 3.5) (a conservative characters-per-token heuristic) and stops with an informative error before making the HTTP request if the estimate exceeds the limit. Use this as a pre-flight guard against accidentally se

inputs.name: timeout
inputs.description: Numeric. Request timeout in seconds, passed to httr2::req_timeout(). Default 120. Raise this for a slow provider/model (e.g. a large local Ollama model) or a large multi-image PDF-vision call that can legitimately take longer than two minutes.

functions.name: change_backbone
functions.description: Translate Taxon Names Between Taxonomic Backbones

inputs.name: input_df
inputs.description: A dataframe returned by verify_taxon_names, containing at minimum: user_supplied_name, matched_name, classification_path, and classification_ranks.

inputs.name: input_col
inputs.description: Character. The name of the column in input_df holding the original (source backbone) names. Typically "user_supplied_name".

inputs.name: old_backbone_label

inputs.name: new_backbone_label
inputs.description: Character. The label to assign to the translated-name column in the output (e.g., "GBIF" or "NCBI"). Default is "translated_name".

inputs.name: keep_unmatched
inputs.description: Logical. When TRUE (the default), names for which the target backbone returns no match are retained by copying the original source name into the translated-name column rather than leaving it NA. Set to FALSE to keep NA for unmatched names (original behaviour).

functions.name: define_search_polygon
functions.description: Define a Search Polygon Interactively

inputs.name: lat
inputs.description: Numeric. Latitude of the centre point in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Ignored when init_polygon is supplied (the centre is derived from the polygon instead). Required otherwise.

inputs.name: lon
inputs.description: Numeric. Longitude of the centre point in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Ignored when init_polygon is supplied. Required otherwise.

inputs.name: radius_deg
inputs.description: Numeric. Half-width of the initial square in decimal degrees. For reference: 1 degree ~= 111 km. Ignored when init_polygon is supplied. Required otherwise.

inputs.name: tile
inputs.description: Character. Leaflet tile provider name. Default "Esri.OceanBasemap". Any string accepted by leaflet::addProviderTiles() works (e.g. "OpenStreetMap", "Esri.WorldImagery").

inputs.name: points
inputs.description: Data frame of observation coordinates to overlay on the map as small, non-interactive reference markers (does not affect the returned polygon). Must have lat and lng columns. Useful for seeing the actual data cloud while drawing a group or search-area boundary around it. Default NULL (no overlay).

inputs.name: group_col
inputs.description: Character. Optional column name in points used to color the reference markers by group (e.g. an already-assigned spatial_group_id), with a legend. Lets a user drawing a broader search area see which points already belong to which group. Default NULL (all markers drawn in one flat color).

inputs.name: init_polygon
inputs.description: Character. An existing WKT POLYGON string (as returned by a previous call to this function) to reopen for editing, instead of starting from a fresh square. Its own vertices become the initial draggable markers. When supplied, lat/lon/ radius_deg are not required and are ignored if given.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Character. Gadget title bar text. Default "Define Search Polygon". Callers embedding this gadget in a larger workflow (e.g. group_observations_by_bbox) should pass something identifying what this particular call is for (e.g. which spatial group or search area is being drawn) -- session experience sh

inputs.name: done_label
inputs.description: Character. Label for the primary (right-hand) title bar button. Default "Done". Override with a verb describing what clicking it actually does in the calling context (e.g. "Group These Points") -- generic "Done" reads as "confirm and proceed," which does not by itself convey that clicking it before

inputs.name: cancel_label
inputs.description: Character. Label for the title bar's cancel button (returns NULL). Default "Cancel". Override with wording describing what not drawing anything means in the calling context (e.g. "No More Groups").

inputs.name: viewer
inputs.description: A shiny gadget viewer, passed to runGadget. Default shiny::paneViewer(minHeight = 500) (renders in RStudio's own Viewer pane) -- matches the viewer style already used by this ecosystem's other interactive mapping gadgets (TaxaHabitat::review_spatial_flags()), so all mapping interactions look and fee

inputs.name: fallback_backbone_id

inputs.name: verbose
